title: 🔥 IS TITHING JUST ABOUT MONEY? THE TRUTH MOST CHURCHES WON’T TELL YOU! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 IS TITHING JUST ABOUT MONEY? THE TRUTH MOST CHURCHES WON’T TELL YOU! 🔥
📖 Romans 12:1 – "Present your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and acceptable to God, which is your spiritual worship."

Most churches today teach that tithing is about giving 10% of your income. Every Sunday, pastors quote Malachi 3:10 to tell people they are "robbing God" if they don’t give financially. But is tithing just about money?
🚨 What if God wants more than your money? What if true biblical tithing is about your entire life, not just 10%?
👉 Let’s break free from tradition and see what the Bible actually teaches!

🔥 1. THE OLD TESTAMENT TITHE WAS NEVER JUST ABOUT MONEY
📖 Deuteronomy 14:22-23 – "Be sure to set aside a tenth of all that your fields produce each year... so that you may learn to revere the Lord your God always."
The original tithe was not about money—it was about giving back to God what He had already given.

🔥 The tithe in the Old Testament included:
✔️ Crops and harvests (Leviticus 27:30)
✔️ Livestock and animals (Leviticus 27:32)
✔️ Special feasts and offerings (Deuteronomy 14:23)
❌ NOWHERE does the Bible say that tithing was strictly about money!

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Imagine a farmer in ancient Israel. He didn’t go to the temple and drop money in a basket—he gave the first fruits of his harvest, his best livestock, and his time in service to God.
👉 Tithing was about giving the BEST of what God had blessed you with—not just finances!

🔥 2. THE NEW TESTAMENT NEVER COMMANDS CHRISTIANS TO TITHE MONEY
📖 2 Corinthians 9:7 – "Each one must give as he has decided in his heart, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver."
🔥 The New Testament never commands believers to give a mandatory 10%!

❌ Jesus never told His disciples to tithe money.
❌ The apostles never told the early church to tithe money.
❌ Nowhere in the New Testament is financial tithing a command.
Instead, Jesus and the apostles taught giving from the heart, led by the Spirit.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If a poor widow gives her last $5 to God, while a rich businessman gives 10% of his millions but has no true sacrifice, who gave more in God’s eyes?
📖 Mark 12:43-44 – "This poor widow has put in more than all the others... she gave out of her poverty, but they all gave out of their wealth."
👉 God is not looking for a fixed percentage—He is looking for true surrender!

🔥 3. WHAT DID JESUS SAY ABOUT "TALENTS"? IT’S NOT JUST MONEY!
📖 Matthew 25:14-30 – "To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, each according to his ability."
Many people assume that "talents" in this parable refer to money. But in biblical times, a "talent" was a measurement of weight, not just currency.

🔥 Your talents include:
✔️ Your gifts and abilities – Preaching, teaching, music, serving, evangelism
✔️ Your time and energy – Every breath you take belongs to God
✔️ Your life itself – Surrendering everything to His will

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A musician has the ability to write songs for God’s glory. A teacher has the ability to disciple others in the Word. If they only give money but never use their God-given gifts, have they truly given to God?
👉 Tithing is not about 10% of your income—it’s about 100% of your life!

🔥 4. GOD WANTS YOUR WHOLE LIFE, NOT JUST 10%!
📖 Romans 12:1 – "Present your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and acceptable to God, which is your spiritual worship."
🔥 True giving is not about a percentage—it’s about TOTAL SURRENDER!

✔️ Giving your time in worship and prayer
✔️ Serving others with the gifts God gave you
✔️ Using your career, talents, and passions for God’s glory
✔️ Living every day as a sacrifice, fully committed to Christ

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A man faithfully gives 10% of his paycheck every Sunday, but he never prays, never shares the gospel, and never seeks to grow in faith. Has he truly given to God?
🚨 God doesn’t need your money—He wants YOU!

🔥 5. IF TITHING ISN’T REQUIRED, SHOULD CHRISTIANS STILL GIVE?
📖 Acts 2:44-45 – "They sold property and possessions to give to anyone who had need."
🔥 Giving is not about obligation—it’s about love.

✔️ Give generously to support the work of the kingdom.
✔️ Give to help the poor and those in need.
✔️ Give as the Holy Spirit leads, not as a religious requirement.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If someone is struggling financially, they should not feel pressured to give money. Instead, they can give their time, service, and love to others. Giving should be led by the Spirit, not by guilt or manipulation.
👉 A true giver doesn’t ask, "How much do I HAVE to give?" but "How much CAN I give for God’s glory?"

🔥 FINAL WARNING: STOP LIMITING YOUR GIVING TO 10%!
📖 Matthew 6:21 – "For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also."
🚨 If your giving is only about money, you’re missing the point.

💡 REAL-LIFE DECISION:
✔️ Will you surrender everything to God, including your talents and time?
❌ Or will you hold back, thinking 10% is enough?
📖 Luke 14:33 – "Whoever does not give up everything they have cannot be My disciple."
👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER OF SURRENDER
"Lord, I give You everything—not just my money, but my time, my talents, and my whole life. Use me for Your glory. Teach me to give freely, without fear or obligation, but with a heart full of love. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
